quality.formulaHintNumeric: A Python expression evaluated on the readings the inspector enters. Use reading_1 to reading_10 for the individual readings (an empty one counts as 0) and mean for their average. The reading is Accepted when the expression is true, and Rejected when it is false.
quality.formulaHintText: A Python expression evaluated on the result the inspector types. The only value available is reading_value — the text entered in the Reading Value field. The reading is Accepted when the expression is true, and Rejected when it is false.
quality.formulaUnknownVariableNumeric: Not available in a formula over numeric readings: {names}. A numeric formula can use reading_1 to reading_10 and mean.
quality.formulaUnknownVariableText: Not available in a formula over a text result: {names}. A text formula can use reading_value only.
